rows.ARS:
Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: DICwisp
Exhibition name: Whisper ™
rows.Bloom: White. Mild, musk fragrance. 30 to 35 petals. Average diameter 5". Very large, full (26-40 petals), borne mostly solitary, high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Long, pointed, ovoid buds.
rows.Habit:
Medium foliage.

Height: 5¼' to 5'11" (160 to 180cm). Width: 39" to 47" (100 to 120cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b and warmer. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.
